list: Official 55 trophies as published by PlayStation, frozen 2026-11-18

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment your 54th other trophy does — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat A Long Road (100% completion) as the real final boss: everything else feeds into it. Keep this tracker at 54/55 and the platinum is yours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies
A Long Road (100% completion) is the last one for most players
No online play or DLC is needed

trophies.guide: The opening mission and your first story trophy — it unlocks automatically once Gone Fishing ends, in Chapter 1. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss; just play the intro. If you are hunting the platinum, start the habits that matter here: scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study new animals through binoculars.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing
Follow the on-screen objectives to the end
Trophy pops at the mission results screen

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do the one missable in the game: after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a manual save at the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through all Chapter 1 missions
Do the Jason's-house meditation before moving on
Trophy pops when the chapter closes

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2's story missions. The last meditation spots only open once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in this chapter — start working through the meditation spots now. There is no mission replay, but chapter trophies pop on completion, so none of them can be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through all Chapter 2 missions
After Coffee Break, meditate at the spots both characters can reach
Trophy pops when the chapter closes

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. By now the stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) should be appearing — pick them up as you meet them, since their finales carry trophies of their own. Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through all Chapter 3 missions
Take stranger missions as they appear
Trophy pops when the chapter closes

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter — start them, because the 100% checklist needs all 8 bank vaults and Maximum Withdrawal needs 5. Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through all Chapter 4 missions
Start the optional bank-job mission when it appears
Trophy pops when the chapter closes

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Chapter 5. This is the second gold trophy and the story's capstone — after the credits you return to free roam, and everything needed for 100% is still available. Save before the finale; the ending choice is yours.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Reach the final mission in Chapter 5
Complete it
Free roam opens after the credits

trophies.guide: A story mission trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. It pops on completion and cannot be missed — there is no way to fail out of a story trophy permanently, and no mission replay is needed for it.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears
Complete the mission objectives
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story-gated, so this pops naturally as you play through the chapters — prepare with full ammo and armour before you start, and keep a chapter-end save.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears
Complete the heist
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it unlocks on completion and cannot be missed. It is one of the 28 hidden trophies, so it stays secret on your profile until it pops.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story until Child's Play appears
Complete the mission
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A hidden story trophy that pops on completion. Headliners is a late-story mission, so it arrives in the back half of the playthrough — just keep following the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story until Headliners appears
Complete the mission
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can happens — an unscheduled departure from VCIA — so keep that trophy in mind while you are in the area.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears
Complete the mission
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A hidden late-story trophy that pops on completion. Once the story missions are done, the remaining work is the 100% checklist and cleanup — see the roadmap.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears
Complete the mission
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the real platinum gate: reach 100% on the completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only becomes visible after the story. The requirements are lenient — closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Roughly 100 hours after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist
Work the checklist in the roadmap's order
The trophy pops at 100%

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts of any kind — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. There are 397 stunts in the world and 100% completion needs 300, so you will pass 250 naturally while chasing the checklist. Use the in-game stunt markers and chain stunt jumps in free roam.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Find stunt jumps and ramps across Leonida
Land 250 stunts of any kind
Track the count with YOUR COUNT above

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game arcade, bowling and drone racing (per PowerPyx's list). One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything. Tick them off as you sample them during the story.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try fishing once
Try hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, bowling and a drone race once each
Trophy pops after the 9th type

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There is a range in each region; gold medals need fast, accurate shooting, so use a weapon you control well and learn each challenge's target pattern before the timed run. The 100% checklist needs every range too, so this is not optional for the platinum.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit every Shooting Range
Learn each challenge's targets
Earn gold in all 42 challenges

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are short, technical circuits — learn each course's gates, cut corners only where the gates allow, and retry a location until the win lands. All 14 wins are also needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations
Win one race at each
Retry a location until the win registers

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race counts once, so vary the events instead of repeating one. Races appear across Leonida in cars, bikes and boats; use the fastest vehicle class you own for each event and learn the route before pushing.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races across Leonida
Win 20 different ones
Each distinct race counts once

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, accept the challenge, and out-fish him: watch the tension meter, reel steadily, and let the line slacken before it snaps. Losing costs nothing — challenge him again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot
Accept the fishing challenge
Out-fish him without snapping the line

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade in Leonida. Any game counts — pick the shortest one, learn its controls in the first minute, and play through to its end screen. It also counts toward Master of None's activity types.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Enter an arcade
Pick any arcade game
Play it through to completion

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so switch to Lucia for it. Stranger finales stay available after the story — every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back in free roam — so you can finish this in cleanup if you missed it during the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Meet Andy and play her missions as Lucia
Complete the final mission in the strand
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton's strand is boat-flavoured — expect water work — and like the other stranger finales it stays available after the story, so finish it in cleanup if needed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Meet Kenton and play his missions
Complete the final mission in the strand
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy's strand is built around riding — take it at a steady pace and it finishes naturally. Stranger finales return after the story, so this is safe to leave for cleanup.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Meet Billy and play his missions
Complete the final mission in the strand
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. There are more than 8 strangers in Leonida, so pick the shortest strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each carry a finale trophy, and any 8 completed strands count. Do them as they appear during the story; the rest can wait for cleanup.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Meet strangers across Leonida
Complete 8 full strands
Stranger finales stay available after the story

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy's strand is a supply-run chain — keep a fast car ready for its deliveries. It stays available after the story like the other stranger finales.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Meet Randy and play his missions
Complete the final mission in the strand
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so switch to Jason for it. It stays available after the story, so finish it during cleanup if the story swept past it.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Meet Tyrone and play his missions as Jason
Complete the final mission in the strand
Trophy pops at the results screen

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, with both characters where a spot allows. THE ONE MISSABLE: after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1, Lucia can be found at Jason's house in the morning — follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation before Chapter 1 ends. The last spots only open once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.missableNote: After the mission Down to Earth, Lucia meditates at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — do the balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends. There is no mission replay, and this is the one trophy the guides flag as potentially missable.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: After Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia at Jason's house — before Chapter 1 ends
After Coffee Break, meditate at the remaining spots with both characters
18 spots across 10 locations

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is Jason-only — track the animal with the hunting scope, approach downwind, and take the shot cleanly. Bret's quests are also needed for 100%, so finish the whole strand.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunting quests as Jason
Track the unique animal
Take it down for Bret

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses and odd corners — so grab them whenever you pass a likely spot and use a map once you have two sets nearly done. You need only 3 of 18 for the trophy; 100% wants 15 complete sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards across Leonida
Complete any 3 sets
Track sets with YOUR COUNT above

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. Open WAiNK whenever you arrive somewhere new and scan before you leave; the 100% checklist also wants 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, so make scanning a habit from Chapter 1.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app at new places
Scan 100 locations
Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count

trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 challenges (eight groups of ten). Pick the easiest groups first — only 70 of 80 are needed for 100%, so you can skip the hardest ten entirely. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and activities, so they fill in naturally as you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the Challenges menu
Finish 50 across any groups
Skip the hardest ones — only 70 of 80 matter for 100%

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Use a fast car and a quiet corner of the map to break line of sight, then stay out of the search cones until the stars clear. Do it while your partner is available in the story.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along
Raise a 4-star wanted level
Break line of sight and escape until the stars clear

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — keep the stars up between robberies and do not get busted or let the heat die. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and drive on before the police box you in.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner
Rob a shop, then two more back-to-back
Keep the wanted level alive between robberies

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in and drive each new model once and it counts. Leonida holds 277 base models and the 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so keep driving everything new you see and use WAiNK to check what you have already found.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive every new vehicle model you find
100 discoveries count
WAiNK shows what you have already scanned

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus (the slow-aim ability). Start a fight with a group of five or more, trigger Combat Focus, and chain headshots while time is slowed. Wanted-level shootouts and gang hideouts give you the crowd you need.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a group of 5+ enemies
Trigger Combat Focus
Down 5 before it ends

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — steal a plane and take off without a flight plan. The airport is busy and guarded, so grab a plane on the far side of the runway, throttle up fast, and climb away from the response.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA
Steal a plane
Take off without a schedule

trophies.guide: The trophy's own description is a joke that hides the requirement — it involves the Rhino tank, and PowerPyx's per-trophy notes list the exact trigger. In practice, seek a tank encounter during a high-wanted shootout or a military event, deal with the Rhino, and check the cited guide before you grind it so you do the right thing first time.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank encounter
Deal with the Rhino
Check PowerPyx for the exact trigger first

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — plan the route, go at a quiet hour, move slowly past cameras and staff, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails: leave, lose any heat, and try again — there is no penalty for retrying.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store
Enter undetected and take the goods
Leave before the alarm — retry if spotted

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in total and 100% needs all of them. Plan each vault's escape route before you go in — a fast car parked close by matters more than the robbery itself.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Open bank jobs via the Chapter 4 optional mission
Rob a vault and escape
Repeat for 5 vaults (8 exist)

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes through the city — block one, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the heat before the response builds. A quiet stretch of road and a fast getaway car make it easy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route
Stop it and crack it open
Escape with the cash

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — drive, fly or sail into every named area until the map fills in. The last few areas are the small islands and the far corners of the map; check the in-game map for gaps and sweep them in one long drive.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel across the whole map
Enter all 52 areas
Sweep islands and corners last

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are marked once you find them — hit one per gang and the trophy pops. There are 39 gang operations in total and 100% needs them all, so this trophy is the start of a longer grind.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find gang operations across Leonida
Rob one for each of the 9 gangs
39 operations exist; 100% needs them all

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and take it to the beachfront — the trophy pops once you are drinking with the view. A quiet, easy trophy to grab early.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach
Order a cocktail at a beachfront bar
Enjoy it with the view

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — drive a car straight through the showroom glass in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom, line up a fast car outside, and floor it through the front. The damage bill is part of the fun.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom
Get a fast car
Smash out through the glass

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a frame and follow through. Any game counts; the trophy pops for playing, not for a score. It also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play a game of bowling
Trophy pops for playing

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — the description hides the moment, so treat this as a story-adjacent surprise: it pops during a partner scene. Keep playing the story with your partner and it arrives on its own; check PowerPyx's per-trophy notes if you want the exact scene.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play the story with your partner
It pops during a partner scene
See PowerPyx for the exact moment

trophies.guide: Make choices across the story — the game tracks the decisions you make, and this pops once you have made enough of them. There is no wrong answer for the trophy: pick what fits your playthrough and keep choosing when the game asks. Some choices are one-time, so decide deliberately.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play the story
Make choices when the game offers them
The trophy pops after enough choices

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then clear it on the immediate retry. The natural way it pops is failing a mission or challenge and passing it on the next attempt, so do not reload an old save after a failure: retry and finish it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail a mission or challenge
Retry it right away
Pass on the second attempt

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — an odd event somewhere in Leonida. The description hides the event; it is one of the game's hidden joke trophies, so explore odd places at odd hours and check PowerPyx's per-trophy notes for the exact spot.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners
Trigger the strange event
See PowerPyx for the exact spot

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, time the swing, and the trophy pops on the hit. Bowling-alley brawls do not count; it has to be a drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Drive past a pedestrian slowly
Land a melee hit from the vehicle

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up across the whole game. Robberies feed this directly, so it fills in while you chase Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% robbery list.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob to collect Marked Bills
Launder them through contacts

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, car mods and food all count. The total adds up across the whole game, so just play normally and buy what you need; if you are close at the end, mod a car or restock ammo to top it up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear, clothes and car mods
Spending counts across all shops

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages cost money, so this lands late — save the purchases for cleanup, when robbery money is flowing. Each garage also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find the 8 garage properties
Buy each one
Do it in cleanup when money is flowing

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — open the app, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat. Any 10 vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most and the rare ones you find while exploring.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Register a vehicle
Repeat for 10 vehicles
